Account & Data Deletion – Demumu: Are You Dead?

  • Developer: Brainpower Studio
  • Package ID: com.demucheck

This page explains how users of Demumu: Are You Dead?, developed by Brainpower Studio, can request deletion of their account and associated personal data.

How to Request Account Deletion

Request Account Deletion

You can make a request without signing in to or installing the app. Please leave passwords and payment details out of your email.

  1. Select Request Account Deletion to open an email draft.
  2. Send the email to brainpower.appstudio@gmail.com. If the button doesn’t open an email draft, you can write to that address directly.
  3. Include the email address or account ID linked to this app, if applicable.
  4. Ask us to delete your account and its associated data.
  5. Our support team will verify and process your request.

Request Data Deletion

Email us with the specific personal data you want deleted while keeping your account. Support will confirm whether it can fulfill your request.

Request Data Deletion

What Data Will Be Deleted

Once we verify an account deletion request, we delete the account and all associated user data, subject to any legally required retention.

Data Retention

Routine retention ends when the account is deleted. If a legal obligation requires retention, we keep only the affected records for the required period.

Processing Time

We process account deletion requests within 7 days once we have enough information to verify the request.

Need Help?
